note.timeout_clamped_live: timeout_min clamped from {{from}} to {{to}} (the backend watchdog bounds any retained command to this)
note.entries_clamped: entries clamped from {{from}} to {{to}} (LOG_RING_ENTRIES — the ring lives in RTC memory and cannot grow at runtime)
note.cleared: Topic cleared — the node exits service mode on the next loop (~100 ms).
note.ping: The node responds on status and clears the retained topic on its own.
note.reboot: The retained topic clears automatically as soon as the node confirms the reboot. boot_count starts over: that's expected and will be flagged as such.
note.capture_stopped: Capture stopped. The node's memory is cleared: any events not yet transferred are lost.
note.capture_started: The node applies the config, clears the retained topic and continues its normal cycle — it does not enter service mode. Capturing costs no energy; the cost is in transferring the logs afterward.
note.live_forced: Forced session: the node skips its panel-voltage floor, so this runs without sun. The node caps a forced session at 30 min regardless of timeout_min, and the pack floor, the budget and the MQTT floor all still apply.
note.live_armed: The node stops sleeping and publishes every ~{{interval}} s (it adds its sensor-read time on top). Costs about 53 mAh per hour, against ~47 mAh for a full day of the normal cycle. It exits on its own when the panel, the pack, the budget or the broker say so.

cantWhy.broker_down: The backend is not connected to the MQTT broker.
cantWhy.fetch_in_progress: A download is already in progress.
cantWhy.needs_service_mode: The node needs to be in service mode: outside a session it sleeps almost the whole cycle and doesn't listen to the request topic.

anomaly.duplicate: Two payloads with the same boot_count outside live mode: the same cycle was delivered twice.
anomaly.reset_spontaneous: Spontaneous boot_count reset: RTC memory wiped with no reflash — watchdog or brownout signature.
anomaly.reset_reboot: Expected boot_count reset: a reboot was ordered moments ago. Any restart wipes RTC memory, so the counter starts over.
anomaly.reset_service: Expected boot_count reset: there was a recent service mode session, and a reflash wipes RTC memory.
anomaly.gap_one: {{count}} telemetry payload did not arrive: the node woke up but the publish didn't go through.
anomaly.gap_other: {{count}} telemetry payloads did not arrive: the node woke up but the publish didn't go through.

captureNote.dump_not_multiple: The dump is {{bytes}} B, which is not a multiple of {{entrySize}}: the trailing {{trailing}} B were discarded.
captureNote.no_anchors: No reference telemetry: boot_count values are the raw 16 bits and no times were reconstructed.
captureNote.no_anchor_in_range: No cycle in the capture published telemetry: there is no anchor point to reconstruct times from.
captureNote.implausible_boot_range: Implausible boot_count range ({{cycles}} cycles): reconstructed times are omitted.
captureNote.interpolated_times: {{interpolated}} of {{total}} entries have an interpolated time (their cycle did not publish telemetry). The deep sleep timer runs on an RC oscillator with ±5%, so the drift grows with distance from the nearest anchored cycle.
captureNote.no_entries: The node has no captured entries yet.
captureNote.ring_wraparound: The ring overwrote {{dropped}} entries via wraparound: the capture is truncated at the start and may not cover the event being looked for.
captureNote.clear_unconfirmed: The capture downloaded fully but the node did not confirm the clear: it's still occupying the ring and logging may still be active.
captureNote.pre_restart_untimed_one: {{count}} event before a node restart is left with no time: that restart reset boot_count to zero, so its cycle number belongs to a different series and cannot be anchored against telemetry.
captureNote.pre_restart_untimed_other: {{count}} events before a node restart are left with no time: that restart reset boot_count to zero, so their cycle numbers belong to a different series and cannot be anchored against telemetry. The order between them is still correct.

tier.1: Full operation · Rail A + Rail B ON
tier.2: Rail A ON · Rail B OFF

riskNote.safe: Wide margin for a 15 min session.
riskNote.caution: Short session (timeout ≤ 5 min) and avoid repeated flashes.
riskNote.unsafe: Do not flash: risk of a brownout mid-write from sag under load.

logCode.LOG_BOOT: boot - reset={{b}} (8=deep sleep wake; any other value resets boot_count)
logCode.LOG_PUBLISH_FAIL: publish failed - {{b}} B, cause {{a}} (1=doesn't fit in buffer, 2=connection dropped)
logCode.LOG_SERVICE_EXIT: exiting service mode - reason {{a}} (1=timeout 2=server 3=mqtt down), {{b}} s
